days.subject: Let’s Explore Your Pool Duck Territory
body: Hi {{contact.first_name}},
It’s Lee from Pool Duck, you may remember us from our 20-foot inflatable duck. We had a tremendous weekend, and I appreciated you taking the time to connect!
Now that you’ve had some time to unpack the show, I’d love to circle back on your key takeaways and explore how Pool Duck aligns with your business goals.

Let’s take a deeper dive into your target market, review the number of pools in your preferred territory, and assess the opportunity. Following our call we’ll share our Franchise Disclosure Document (FDD) so you can take a closer look at the financial information.
In a focused 30-minute conversation, we can recap what stood out, answer your questions, and align on actionable next steps.
[Book a Time to Explore Your Territory](booking)

days.subject: What’s it like to own a Pool Duck?
body: Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Don’t just take our word for it. Hear directly from the Pool Duck franchise partners who leaned into the opportunity and took the next step. In this short video, our owners share real-world insights and provide a firsthand look at being part of the flock!
[Watch the Franchisee Testimonial](video)
I’d love to dive into your questions, and explore territory options.
days.sms: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, it’s Lee from Pool Duck! Hear from the voices of Pool Duck that took the next step to help you picture what ownership looks like. {video}

days.subject: Here’s what you’d have behind you at Pool Duck
body: Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Entrepreneurial vision sets the direction. The right infrastructure helps you execute. With Pool Duck, you’re investing in an ownership ecosystem that combines industry expertise, purpose-built technology, and hands-on support to translate your ambitions into an actionable go-to-market strategy.
Here’s what that value proposition looks like in practice:

**Three decades of operational expertise, built into your playbook.** Leverage 30 years of pool business ownership experience, established operating processes, and 500+ hours of owner training. It’s institutional knowledge translated into practical owner enablement, connecting strategy with day-to-day execution.

**An in-house marketing team to activate your local go-to-market strategy.** Tap into pool-industry advertising expertise, targeted campaigns, and strategic guidance built around your ideal customers. Align your market positioning with a team that understands the industry.

**A pre-configured tech stack to operationalize your launch.** Your CRM and Pool Brain come fully built out to manage leads, coordinate routes, and streamline workflows. Put the infrastructure to work without assembling your operational toolkit from scratch.

**Emmy Award-winning creative expertise to amplify your brand.** Leverage an in-house Emmy Award-winning videographer for professional video content and branded advertising. Bring a cohesive identity to your market with creative assets that help you cut through the noise.

**An exclusive territory backed by a collaborative ownership ecosystem.** Establish your local footprint with ongoing coaching, operational guidance, and a network of fellow franchise owners. Pair entrepreneurial autonomy with hands-on support.

**Optional customer-base acquisition support for a buy-and-build approach.** Explore purchasing an established book of customers, with assistance identifying and evaluating pool routes. Add another strategic option to your market-entry roadmap.
Ready to move beyond the overview? Let’s double-click on the value included in your investment, pressure-test the strategic fit, and align on an actionable path forward.
Schedule your call here for a [Strategic Deep Dive](booking)

days.subject: Meet the people behind the duck
body: Hi {{contact.first_name}},

At Pool Duck, owner enablement isn’t an afterthought. We’ve brought together a cross-functional team with expertise in pool operations, marketing, and business technology, backed by training designed to help you put those resources to work.
As a franchise partner, you’ll have:
**500+ hours of owner training.** Build operational fluency, develop practical skills, and learn how to activate the systems supporting your business.
**Ongoing coaching and strategic guidance.** Access a team that can serve as a sounding board, help you navigate challenges, and support informed decision-making.
The objective is simple: help you run and build your route with clarity and confidence with Pool Duck alongside you from day one.
Let’s double-click on the training roadmap.
Schedule a call here to: **[Let’s Talk Training & Support](booking)**
days.sms:
Hey {{contact.first_name}}, Lee from Pool Duck! We take preparing our owners seriously: 500+ hours of training, 30 years of pool business experience, and ongoing coaching—so you have the knowledge and support to get started with confidence.

Let’s talk about the people behind the duck: {booking}

days.subject: More Revenue with Repairs
body: Hi {{contact.first_name}},
**Your revenue opportunities don’t have to stop at weekly pool cleaning.**
When a customer needs an equipment repair, Pool Duck handles the work under its contractor license. You can participate in the repair program without performing the repairs yourself.

**That’s one of the things that sets Pool Duck apart:** licensed repair support backed by a team based right here in Tampa. We know the local pool market, and we’re in your backyard to help you serve it.
Let’s take 15 minutes to discuss how the program works for franchise partners and explore your territory options.
Schedule a call here to **[Talk Training & Support](booking)**
